summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting a share buy-back for its employee share programs. The buy-back program, announced 4 Feb 2026, runs 13 Feb 2026 to 15 Jan 2027, with a total purchase amount of NOK 1,971,000,000 and a maximum of 19,600,000 shares. On 15 Jun 2026, Equinor purchased 486,072 own shares at an average price of NOK 327.1115 per share. After the transaction, Equinor holds 66,774,249 own shares, or 2.61% of share capital. The shares are intended for employee incentive programs and capital reduction. This is a routine capital return filing with no special-situation premium or strategic change; watch for continued buy-back pace and share capital reduction progress.
